1. Non-Affiliation Disclaimer

This application is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected with any government agency, registered administrative authority, or official taxi operating organization. It is a completely independent application provided only for the convenience of recording and managing the daily income and expense accounts of ride-sharing and taxi drivers at a personal level.

2. Accuracy of Information & User Responsibility

All calculations, reports, and information presented in the application are prepared entirely based on information entered by the user. The app owner or developer will not be liable for any mathematical discrepancy, decision-making error, or indirect financial loss caused by incorrect, incomplete, or untrue information provided by the user.

3. Data Protection & Privacy

We respect user privacy. This application does not collect, track, store on a central server, transfer, or sell personally identifiable information (PII) to any third party. Information entered in the app is stored only in the local memory of the user's own device, subject to the separate Privacy Policy.

4. Right to Modification

The app owner reserves the sole and final right to change, amend, modify, or add to the functionality, layout, security, or terms of use of the application at any time without prior notice.

5. Binding Agreement

By installing, browsing, or using this application, the user is deemed to have read, understood, and unconditionally agreed to this disclaimer and all related legal terms and conditions.

6. Privacy Policy

For information about location data, local storage, advertising, third-party services, and children's privacy, please read the Privacy Policy section of this app.

🔒 Privacy Policy for Taxi Driver

Thank you for using the Taxi Driver mobile application. Protecting the privacy of user information is one of our top priorities. This Privacy Policy explains the rules regarding the use of data by the app.
🌐 Translate Privacy Policy
Powered by Google Translate
Online translation by Google Translate. Internet connection required.

1. Location and Location Data

The app does not currently use or collect the precise location (GPS Location) of your device for its current features. Navigation and route-tracking features, as well as related data collection, may be introduced in the future.

Purpose of use: If location-based features are introduced in the future, location information may be used for taxi driver income and expense management, distance calculation, navigation assistance, and route tracking.

2. Data Collection & Local Storage

Personal Information: At present, the app does not collect or store confidential or sensitive personal data on external servers operated by the developer.

Local Storage: App settings and taxi-driver-related information entered into the app are stored only in the local memory of your device (Local Storage).

Data-collection servers or server-based features may be introduced in the future. If this happens, this Privacy Policy will be updated to explain the applicable data practices.

3. Advertising (Google AdMob)

To support free services, the app may display Google AdMob or other advertisements in the future.

Advertising-related Data: If Google AdMob is used, Google may use the device's Advertising ID, IP Address, and technical information to display relevant advertisements.

Controls: You may be able to turn off personaliBooking advertising or manage/delete your Advertising ID through the advertising settings available on your device, such as Settings > Google > Ads, depending on your device and Android version.

4. Future Data Collection

The app developer does not currently operate a data-collection server for the app. If server-based data collection or additional online services are introduced in the future, the Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.

5. Children's Privacy

This app is not designed for children, and no data is knowingly collected from children.

6. Future Changes

The app's features, data collection practices, server services, navigation, route tracking, or advertising may change in the future. Any applicable changes will be reflected in an updated Privacy Policy.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us by email:
